none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Nonconvex objectives and components are permitted; neither global convexity nor strong convexity is required.

problem_class.label: quasar
problem_class.details: F is (γ,μ)-strongly quasar-convex relative to a global minimizer x*: γ(F(x)−F(x*))≤⟨∇F(x),x−x*⟩−γμ‖x−x*‖²/2, with 0<γ≤1 and 0<μ≤L.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SimilarFiniteSumQuasar.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, existential minimizer clause.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F(x)=(1/n)∑ᵢ fᵢ(x), with n≥1 and differentiable components.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i,x) returns exactly ∇fᵢ(x), independently of call index and oracle seed. Each component evaluation counts as one call; computing ∇F(x) directly requires n calls. No function-value or proximal oracle is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SimilarFiniteSumQuasar.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply and spec.admissible, oracle-answer equality; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every component and all x,y, ‖(∇fᵢ−∇F)(x)−(∇fᵢ−∇F)(y)‖≤δ‖x−y‖. Here δ≥0 and 384δ²≤γ³μ². This bounds spatial variation of gradient discrepancies, not their magnitude; interpolation and bounded sampling variance are not assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SimilarFiniteSumQuasar.lean: spec.valid and spec.admissible, component discrepancy inequality.

distinctive_assumptions.label: quadratic_growth
distinctive_assumptions.details: For the specified global minimizer, F(x)−F(x*)≥γμ‖x−x*‖²/[2(2−γ)]. Initialization satisfies F(x₀)−F(x*)≤Δ, with Δ≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: F has L-Lipschitz gradient and lower curvature −γ√(μL): F(y)≥F(x)+⟨∇F(x),y−x⟩−γ√(μL)‖y−x‖²/2. The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space. E,L,x₀,n,μ,γ,δ,Δ,ε are public; the component functions and minimizer are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SimilarFiniteSumQuasar.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Gradient.Public.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point x satisfies F(x)−F(x*)≤ε for a global minimizer x*, with ε>0.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap inequality holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within a fixed public oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines strongly quasar-convex finite-sum optimization with uniformly small component-gradient discrepancy variation, a parameter-dependent lower-curvature restriction, Hilbert-space geometry, and almost-sure accuracy under a fixed oracle budget.
